cohort: 55 women with congenital heart disease who delivered at a single institution over a 10 year period
finding: Maternal and fetal outcomes were excellent in both women with surgically corrected and uncorrected congenital heart disease, with no significant differences observed between the groups.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the mode of delivery between women with operated and non-operated congenital heart disease.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2516.65 ± 514.04 gm in the non-operated group and 2683.00 ± 366.00 gm in the operated group.
